newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai's Pudong to have natural gas on line.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai's Pudong to have natural gas on line.

text.p: Shanghai's Pudong district will provide its residents with piped natural gas in about a year's time, the China Daily Business Weekly reported on Sunday.
The newspaper said work began recently on the natural gas supply network for Pudong, which will become the first user of gas from the Pinghu gas and oil field in the East China Sea.
The Pinghu project is expected to pipe 1.2 million cubic metres of natural gas daily to Pudong from 1998, it said.
